description: You are a pre-calculus teacher creating an interactive GeoGebra lesson on conic sections. Create a construction that demonstrates the geometric definition of the parabola as the locus of all points equidistant from a focus and a directrix. Place the focus F at coordinates (0, 1), define the directrix as the horizontal line y = -1, and use GeoGebra's Locus tool to geometrically generate the parabola — not by entering a function formula. The construction must include: the focus point, the directrix line, a moveable construction point on the directrix, and the locus trace produced as the construction point moves. Add at least one text label or distance measurement annotation that demonstrates the equal-distance property at a point on the parabola. Save as 'parabola_locus.ggb' in ~/Documents/GeoGebra/projects/
